job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a...

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead or participate in product management initiatives and deliverables for product lines or services
* Contribute to product analysis across applicable markets, conduct market research and market results-oriented analysis
* Review and analyze marketing programs for new products or enhancements including identification of market segments, product positioning, product bundling, pricing and profitability
* Resolve moderately complex issues and lead team to meet project goals, objectives and deliverables
* Ensure programs adhere to compliance, privacy regulations and policies
* Collaborate and consult with managers, analysts and project teams to ensure that goals are achieved
* Lead projects, teams or serve as a mentor

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of Product Management experience, product development experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Posting End Date:**

5 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Description**
---------------

Role Objective: The Group Product Manager (GPM) – Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies for assigned product portfolios. The role involves market analysis, brand planning, product lifecycle management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive product growth, market share, and profitability. Principal Tasks & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Brand Strategy & Planning Develop and implement marketing strategies for assigned brands/products. Prepare annual brand plans and promotional strategies aligned with business objectives. Monitor brand performance and take corrective actions to achieve targets. 2. Market Analysis Conduct market research to understand market trends, competition, and customer insights. Analyze prescription trends, sales data, and competitor activities. Identify opportunities for product growth and market expansion. 3. Product Lifecycle Management Manage product lifecycle including product launches, positioning, and growth strategies. Plan and execute new product launches in coordination with cross-functional teams. 4. Promotional Activities Design and implement promotional campaigns, marketing materials, and brand communication. Develop visual aids, promotional inputs, and digital marketing initiatives for field force effectiveness. 5. Field Force Engagement Work closely with the sales team to ensure effective product promotion. Conduct training sessions for field force on product knowledge and marketing strategies. Provide regular updates and guidance to improve field performance. 6. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with Medical, Regulatory, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure smooth product operations. Engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare professionals for brand advocacy. 7. Budget Management Manage marketing budgets and ensure cost-effective utilization. Monitor ROI of marketing activities. Key Skills & Competencies Brand growth and market share Achievement of sales targets Successful product launches Effectiveness of promotional campaigns Field force productivity and engagement

job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Product Manager - UPI & BBPS
job_description:
Designation: NA

Location: India Maharashtra Goregaon R Tech

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Description: Product Manager – UPI & BBPS**

**Experience:** 2–3 Years
  
**Department:** Digital Payments / Product Management
  
**Industry:** Fintech / Digital Payments

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Product Manager to manage and enhance UPI and BBPS (Bharat Connect) journeys, drive product execution, and improve onboarding, transaction success, and customer experience. The role involves close collaboration with engineering, QA, design, analytics, operations, compliance, and banking partners to deliver seamless, reliable, and compliant payment experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Management & Delivery**

* Translate business requirements into PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.
* Manage product backlogs, JIRA, sprint planning, UAT, releases, and post-release monitoring.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver product enhancements and resolve production issues.
* Support roadmap execution, competitor benchmarking, and feature prioritization.

**2. UPI & BBPS Product Management**

* Manage UPI journeys, including onboarding, device binding, SIM verification, bank account linking, UPI ID creation, UPI PIN setup, and payments.
* Drive UPI feature enhancements, including UPI Lite and other applicable capabilities.
* Manage BBPS journeys across bill categories, including biller integration, bill fetch, payment processing, status checks, refunds, reversals, and complaints.
* Coordinate with PSP banks, billers, aggregators, and technology partners to resolve issues and improve transaction performance.
* Support implementation of applicable RBI, NPCI, and Bharat Connect guidelines.

**3. Product Analytics & Performance**

* Configure and validate product events in Mixpanel and GA4 in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams.
* Analyze funnels, cohorts, retention, and drop-offs across onboarding, activation, UPI transactions, and bill payments.
* Track key metrics such as registration conversion, device-binding success, transaction success rates, technical declines, API latency, bill-fetch success, and repeat usage.
* Build performance dashboards and conduct root-cause analysis to identify product gaps and drive measurable improvements.
* Use Excel and, preferably, SQL/BigQuery or BI tools for data analysis and reporting.
  

**4. Customer Experience & Stakeholder Management**

* Identify friction points through customer feedback, complaints, and journey analysis; recommend improvements to reduce drop-offs and payment failures.
* Coordinate with engineering, QA, operations, risk, compliance, and banking partners on integrations, testing, releases, and issue resolution.
* Maintain product documentation, process flows, test scenarios, and release notes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or product execution, preferably in fintech or digital payments.
* Working knowledge of UPI, BBPS/Bharat Connect, payment flows, and customer onboarding journeys.
* Hands-on experience with Mixpanel and/or GA4, including event tracking, funnel analysis, and conversion metrics.
* Familiarity with JIRA, Agile methodologies, PRDs, user stories, and UAT.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, API testing, and system integrations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:** Basic SQL/BigQuery, Power BI or similar tools; exposure to Android/iOS applications, PSP banks, TPAPs, biller aggregators, reconciliation, refunds, and transaction monitoring.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Onboarding, UPI activation, and first-transaction conversion.
* UPI and BBPS transaction success rates.
* Device-binding, bank-linking, and bill-fetch success rates.
* Reduction in transaction failures, technical declines, and funnel drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, repeat transactions, and customer experience.
* Timely delivery of product enhancements and resolution of production issues.

**Ideal Candidate:** A data-driven product professional with a strong understanding of digital payments, product analytics, customer journeys, and cross-functional execution.

**Job Purpose:**  

* Manage business partner and develop relationships for their growth in quality and quantity to uncover business opportunities for assigned BU/territory.
* Position exists to ensure solutions and handle escalated complaints from business partners.
* Sole accountability to assess the market conditions with business partner and discernment of opportunities for the Companys products and services.
* Contribution through Revenue and Margin growth for new and existing business customers

**Responsibilities:**  

* Maintain and grow Revenue number of partners in given territory/BU.
* Revenue and Margin growth for new and existing business customers
* Builds high loyalty and long-term business relationships with the assigned business partner.
* Manage some team members for assigned BU/territory.
* Develops relationships for business partners growth in quality and quantity to uncover business opportunities for assigned BU/territory.
* Provides leadership and guidance customer planning and engagement along with team members.
* Regular monitoring to track progress toward revenue and growth goals.
* Ensuring solutions and handles escalated complaints from business partners.
* Manage operational and daily business inside the team (sales process, pipeline update, follow up to business partner, response to business partner, engagement to business partner, etc.)
* Assessment of market conditions with business partner and discernment of opportunities for the Companys products and services
* Provides on the job training the sales cycle to the team.
* Provides supervision, coaching and warnings/notice when needed.
* Looking for information about competitors
* Development of subordinates, including regarding work performance and motivation
* Comply with and ensure the sales process with company regulation.

**Knowledge Skills and Experience:**  

* 5 to 8 Years of relevant work experience
* 1 to 3 Years of experience directly managing / supervising employees.

**Working Conditions:**  

* Frequent Travel Required (25%).

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

  
Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout
job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

The Checkout Experience team owns one of the most important moments in the buyer journey: helping customers complete their purchase with confidence, speed, and clarity. The space includes guest and member checkout, express payment experiences, checkout success, and key dependencies across cart, payments, shipping, and post-purchase experiences.

  
  

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead complex, high-impact checkout initiatives that reduce friction, improve buyer trust, and unlock conversion at scale. In this role, you will define and drive multiple initiatives across the checkout funnel, influence cross-functional roadmaps, and help shape the future of Checkout Experience.

  
  

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* Lead multiple Checkout Experience initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the biggest sources of buyer friction and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Partner across Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, and adjacent product teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Drive improvements across areas such as guest checkout, member checkout, express payments, delivery clarity, payment optimization, incentives, and checkout success.
* Use analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to make decisions and refine the roadmap.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and align teams around tradeoffs, sequencing, and success metrics.
* Contribute to the longer-term vision for checkout, including personalization, modernized flows, and AI-assisted experiences.
  

  

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Experience owning multiple customer-facing products or features end to end in a consumer, ecommerce, marketplace, or payments environment.
* 8+ years of relevant experience
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and priorities.
* Comfort using data, experimentation, and customer insights to size opportunities and guide decisions.
* Ability to write clear product requirements with strong hypotheses, success metrics, and execution plans.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Domain depth, or quickly demonstrated depth, in checkout, payments, buyer experience, ecommerce, or conversion optimization.
* A bias toward action, strong prioritization instincts, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
### **Job Summary**

We are seeking an enthusiastic and driven Associate Product Manager to join our growing product team. This role is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring product leader to contribute to the development and launch of innovative products. The Associate Product Manager will support the product lifecycle from ideation to launch, working closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver exceptional user experiences and achieve business objectives.  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in conducting market research, competitive analysis, and user interviews to identify market opportunities and user needs.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product manager
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Lead Product Owner / Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our flagship commercial ordering platform in international perimeter . The ideal candidate will drive product vision, prioritize features,perform requirement analysis and ensure seamless delivery to meet business needs and improve user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and prioritize the product backlog aligning with business goals.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, sales, and technical teams.
* Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle, including feature development, releases, and updates.
* Gather and analyze user feedback, market trends, and business requirements to inform product roadmap.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate solutions and ensure quality delivery.
* Team player
* Support compliance, audit requirements, and process improvements.
* Manage stakeholder communication, escalations, and issue resolution to ensure continuous service excellence.

**Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in product management or ownership, preferably in commercial or ordering platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to analyze complex requirements , propose quick win solution and translate them into actionable plans.
* Experience with backlog management, release planning, and cross-team collaboration.

We are seeking a proactive and strategic Lead Product Owner / Product Manager with proven experience in managing commercial or ordering platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong stakeholder management skills, a deep understanding of product lifecycle management, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solutions. Experience in driving product roadmaps, prioritizing features, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions is essential. The candidate should be customer-focused, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities to ensure the continuous enhancement and success of the platform.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

* **Global Opportunities:** Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* **Flexible Work Environment:** Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* **Professional Development:** Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* **Career Growth:** Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* **Caring and Daring Culture:** Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* **Reward Programs:** Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**At Orange, only your skills matter.**

Regardless of your age, gender, background, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, or appearance, we actively encourage diversity within our teams, as it is a collective strength and a driver of innovation.  
Orange is a disability-inclusive employer: please feel free to let us know about any specific needs you may have.

author: Hiring Manager
role: Senior Product Manager - Case Management & BPM
role_title: Senior Product Manager - Case Management & BPM
title: Senior Product Manager - Case Management & BPM
job_description:
***Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.***

  

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers*.* Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

  

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

  

**About the opportunity:**

When a traveler's bag goes missing or a trip is cancelled, what happens next runs on our operations: claims, policy changes, refunds, documents and service requests. We're moving that work onto one enterprise case management and BPM platform, used by up to 2,000 people across North America and Australia–New Zealand first, then Europe.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own it. You'll decide which processes move first, lead our BPM analysts in the US and India, and work with our implementation partner to deliver workflows that cut handling time and manual effort.

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the case management and BPM vision, roadmap and backlog across claims, servicing and operations
* Rank processes by value: volume, handling time, errors, customer impact and regulation
* Design processes once and configure them by region, brand and partner
* Apply a clear automation order: API first, RPA where there's no API, people where judgment matters
* Bring in AI where it pays: document intake, triage, next-best action and handler summaries
* Give handlers one workspace for cases, documents and customer context
* Lead the BPM analyst team and set standards for process design and requirements
* Act as Product Owner with our SI partner: epics, acceptance criteria, sprint reviews and sign-off
* Plan rollout, training and adoption with operations leaders in each region
  

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* 10+ years in product management, operations transformation or BPM
* 5+ years owning a case management or BPM platform such as Pega, Appian, Camunda or ServiceNow
* A track record of automation that measurably cut handling time or cost
* Experience rolling out a shared platform across regions or business units
* Strong process design skills: BPMN, Lean, SLAs and work allocation
* Experience leading analysts and managing SI partners and vendors
* The credibility to bring operations and technology leaders to one plan

**Nice to have**

* Insurance claims, policy servicing or assistance operations experience
* Migration from legacy claims or case systems
* AI in operations: document intake, triage or agent assist
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* BPM platform or Scrum Product Owner certification
  

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

  

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

  

**Job flexibility**. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.

  

**Career growth**. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

  

**Take the time you need, for you and your community**. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

  

**Diversity and inclusion**. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**

* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.
  

***Appy today and let’s go to great places together!***

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
job_description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
* Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
* Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
* Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
* Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

**About the team**
------------------

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Senior A
job_description:
**About the role**

As the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build the platform foundation for understanding how customers adopt and get value from our solutions. You’ll partner with Platform leadership and a dedicated engineering team to deliver shared capabilities that produce trustworthy usage and outcomes data, giving Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams clearer insight to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Through strong product judgment, data-driven learning, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll help teams replace one-off approaches with scalable capabilities, expanding what’s possible for the purpose-driven people and organizations Blackbaud serves.

**What you'll do**

* Own the backlog and product lifecycle for platform capabilities serving engineering and analytics teams, from discovery and validation through delivery and adoption.
* Partner with engineering to build the standards, tools, and guidance product teams need to instrument solutions and publish trustworthy usage data to Blackbaud’s data platform.
* Drive adoption of shared capabilities across the portfolio by understanding product and engineering teams’ needs, supporting onboarding, and helping teams retire one-off approaches.
* Connect platform capabilities to meaningful outcomes by partnering with Customer Success and other internal consumers to understand how usage data can better support their needs.
* Translate strategy, customer insight, data, and stakeholder input into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, documentation, assumptions, and decisions that keep work moving.
* Define hypotheses and success measures, then use adoption, data quality, and feedback to test assumptions and continuously improve the capabilities you own.
* Use AI tools and modern product practices to accelerate discovery, requirements definition, and delivery while proactively communicating progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs across distributed teams.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally including technical product management for internal platforms, developer tools, or data products.
* Demonstrated experience delivering platform capabilities where engineering or analytics teams are the primary consumers.
* Hands-on experience with product analytics tools such as Heap, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Pendo, including event taxonomy and instrumentation design.
* Working knowledge of SQL and modern data platforms; experience with Databricks, medallion data modeling, or Azure data services is a plus.
* Familiarity with web application instrumentation and privacy and consent requirements related to analytics data.
* Experience using agile development practices and tools such as Azure DevOps to deliver products across cross-functional teams.
* Experience turning incomplete information into forward progress by establishing outcomes, testing assumptions with data and feedback, and working effectively across distributed teams and time zones.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our *Intelligence for Good®* vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Product Manager - Domains
job_description:
* R024187

* Pune, Maharashtra, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:**India, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

#### **Join our team**

GoDaddy, the world's largest domain name registrar, helps millions of entrepreneurs globally start, grow, and scale their businesses. People come to GoDaddy to name their idea, build a website and logo, sell their products and services, and accept payments. Airo™, our agentic operating system for small businesses, helps entrepreneurs get their idea online, run their business day-to-day, and grow through an integrated identity, presence, and commerce experience.

Domains are where many of those journeys begin. We have over 20 million customers and manage more than 80 million domains. Beyond registration, we run a domain aftermarket for investors and businesses that want to buy or sell a name. **Afternic** is one of the world's largest domain marketplaces, and GoDaddy Auctions is a leading marketplace for expired domains.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll work on a range of customer problems for both independent entrepreneurs getting their business online and domain investors who buy and sell names at scale. Are you interested in this opportunity? We'd love to hear from you!

#### **What you'll get to do...**

* Own and deliver against your squad's Key Results, from problem framing through launch and readout. Learn fast. Ship frequently and set clear assessment criteria before you build
* Stay close to customers. Talk with them, review their feedback, and let their problems set your priorities
* Design and run experiments. Write clear hypotheses, partner with engineering and design to ship quickly, and interpret results honestly. Not every release will produce a statistically significant result. We expect you to find sound ways to measure what's hard to measure, so you know whether a release is moving your goals in the right direction and whether it hurts other key areas
* Use AI as a tool. Apply it to data analysis, UX design iteration, prototyping, and code where it fits, and apply your own judgment to the output
* Partner across time zones with engineering, design, marketing, and support. Communicate clearly in writing and keep decisions visible

#### **Your experience should include...**

* 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping measurable results
* Experience running A/B tests or other experiments from hypothesis to decision
* Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity and growth mindset that thrives on learning and continuous improvement – progress over perfection
* Skill in pulling relevant data yourself and interpreting it and practical AI fluency. You can describe where it helped you and where you chose not to rely on it
* Strong written and async communication, and comfort working with teammates that we have in other time zones with a focus on solving customer problems over shipping features

**You might also have...**

* Marketplace experience
* Experience with domains, web presence, or e-commerce
* Experience building for small business owners who are growing online
* Experience with financial or investing tools

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...** GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**.* *GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.* *Refer to our full* *EEO policy.*

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. You'll work with engineering, data science, architecture and business leaders to turn complex problems into AI solutions that are safe, scalable and measurable.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product vision and strategy: Set and own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for AI/GenAI products, tied to business goals and enterprise AI priorities
* Problem discovery: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value AI use cases, assess whether they're feasible, and build business cases with clear ROI, savings and capacity metrics
* Backlog ownership: Turn strategy into epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Prioritize the backlog by value, risk and dependencies
* AI solution design: Work with data scientists, ML/LLM engineers and architects on model selection, prompt and agent design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Delivery leadership: Lead agile delivery across scrum teams from idea through POC, pilot, UAT and production, including release planning and go-live readiness
* AI and compliance: Make sure solutions meet
* AI principles, privacy rules (HIPAA, PHI/PII), security and model governance, including bias, explainability and auditability
* Measurement: Define and track product KPIs such as adoption, accuracy, automation rate, cycle-time reduction, cost savings and FTE capacity. Use the data to improve the product
* Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops
* Market awareness: Keep up with trends in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMOps and AI platforms, and bring in new ideas and reusable patterns
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years in product management or technical product ownership
* Experience managing AI/ML, GenAI or intelligent automation products from concept to production
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally or Aha!
* Proven experience building business cases and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
* Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation and MLOps/LLMOps concepts
* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and to work credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Master's degree or MBA
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications
* Experience in US healthcare (payer, provider or PBM), such as claims, utilization management, prior authorization or provider data
* Experience leading distributed, global teams

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking
* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions
* Technical depth in AI
* Executive communication
* Collaboration
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Responsible innovation

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
job_description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

job_description:
Role - Senior Product Manager || Job Location - Bangalore
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define and drive the roadmap for generative AI capabilities across our product suite, including fraud detection, customer support automation, and personalised payment experiences.
  
Work cross-functionally with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to build, launch, and iterate on AI-powered features.
  
Identify customer pain points and develop AI-first product solutions that improve efficiency, security, and user engagement.
  
Evaluate third-party LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and work with internal teams to integrate them securely and effectively.
  
Monitor product performance using data and customer feedback, and use insights to optimise AI models and user interactions.
  
Ensure that all AI product developments comply with applicable financial regulations and data privacy laws, including RBI and GDPR requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
5–8 years of product management experience, including at least 1+ year of experience in AI products; experience in payments or fintech is highly preferred.
  
Strong understanding of generative AI models, including LLMs, transformers, and embeddings, and their applications in real-world products.
  
Proven track record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale.
  
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and communication skills.
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with regulatory sensitivity.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.
  
  
About PayU
  
  
At PayU, we’re building a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. As a global fintech investor operating in 18+ high-growth markets, we extend financial services to underserved populations, help merchants thrive online, and invest in innovative financial technology. As part of Prosus, one of the world’s largest technology investors, we combine global expertise with local market knowledge to create meaningful impact. Learn more at www.payu.com
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
  
  
PayU fosters an environment where everyone belongs regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or religious belief. Our leadership is committed to creating a transparent, flexible workplace where every voice matters and all PayUneers can succeed. We have zero tolerance for discrimination and actively promote equal opportunities across our global organization.
